comment.narrative: As per the Interim Narrative Report Aug.2021 to Jul.2022 p.3With the support of project funds NGOs could afford to hire professional legal staff who carried out legal action quickly and effectively with the help of Huanzhu. Our calculation is based on the fact that the court accepted our application for filing a case.Until now four NGOs filed public interest lawsuits for their first time. Another three NGOs have tried to expand the types of new public interest litigation cases. As the result 166 of the projects predetermined targets 15 cases have been completed.

title.narrative: 1/3: Number of vulnerable people benefiting from legal aid interventions through the action (disaggregated by sex and region)

description.narrative: 1/3: Number of vulnerable people benefiting from legal aid interventions through the action (disaggregated by sex and region)

comment.narrative: As per the Interim Narrative Report Aug.2021 to Jul.2022 p.3The public has been able to obtain an electronic version of Environmental Rights Protection Manuals from the NGOs official account and website which has worked well and has benefited more than 20000 people including more than 14000 women. In the progress of the project one of the NGO partners Shuguang Environmental Protection encountered a mass environmental incident BYD environmental pollution incident. They said that the Environmental Rights Protection Manual was distributed to the polluted people in the form of an electronic version and the effect was very good. More than 14000 of them are women which means 40 of the target has been achieved. Affected by the domestic epidemic the scale of offline activities held decreased compared with expectations and the number of participants decreased.
